cards.ex: I get along with my brother really well; we never argue.
cards.exUz: Men akam bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman; biz hech qachon tortishmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq, do'stona munosabatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They're a close-knit family; they spend all their holidays together.
cards.exUz: Ular ahil oila; ular barcha ta'tillarini birga o'tkazadilar.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda yaqin va doimo yordam beradigan oila.

cards.ex: She fell out with her best friend over a silly misunderstanding.
cards.exUz: U eng yaqin do'sti bilan ahmoqona tushunmovchilik tufayli urushib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Birov bilan janjallashib, munosabatlarni buzmoq.

cards.ex: When I'm feeling down, my mom is always a shoulder to cry on.
cards.exUz: O'zimni yomon his qilsam, onam har doim dardkash.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda yordam beradigan va tasalli beradigan inson.

cards.ex: I think he has a crush on her; he's always looking at her.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, uning ko'ngli unda; u har doim unga qaraydi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni sevib qolmoq, romantik his-tuyg'ularga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They're planning to tie the knot next summer.
cards.exUz: Ular kelasi yozda nikohlanishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Turmush qurmoq, oila qurmoq.

cards.ex: We've been friends through thick and thin; nothing can break us apart.
cards.exUz: Biz yaxshi-yomon kunlarda do'st bo'ldik; hech narsa bizni ajrata olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday qiyinchilik va muammolarga qaramay.

cards.ex: They're like two peas in a pod; they even dress the same.
cards.exUz: Ular ikki tomchi suvga o'xshaydi; ular hatto bir xil kiyinishadi.
cards.term: like two peas in a pod
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda o'xshash odamlar.

cards.ex: We always have a big family gathering at Christmas.
cards.exUz: Biz Rojdestvoda har doim katta oilaviy yig'ilish qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining birga yig'ilishi, bayram yoki tadbir munosabati bilan.

cards.ex: They had a fight, but they patched things up pretty quickly.
cards.exUz: Ular janjallashdi, lekin ular juda tez yarashib olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Janjaldan keyin munosabatlarni tiklamoq.

cards.ex: We hit it off immediately and became good friends.
cards.exUz: Biz darhol til topishib, yaxshi do'st bo'lib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi uchrashuvda bir-birlariga yoqib qolmoq va yaxshi munosabat o'rnatmoq.

cards.ex: I know we argue, but blood is thicker than water, so I'll always be there for him.
cards.exUz: Men bilaman, biz tortishamiz, lekin qon qondosh, shuning uchun men har doim u uchun bo'laman.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari o'rtasidagi munosabatlar boshqalardan muhimroq.

cards.ex: We used to be close, but we've been drifting apart lately.
cards.exUz: Biz ilgari yaqin edik, lekin so'nggi paytlarda uzoqlashib bormoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan munosabatlarning zaiflashishi.

cards.ex: I believe everyone has a soulmate out there somewhere.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, har kimning qayerdadir qalb sadosi bor.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda mos keladigan va chuqur aloqaga ega bo'lgan inson.

cards.ex: This necklace is a family heirloom; it's been passed down for generations.
cards.exUz: Bu marjon oilaviy meros; u avloddan-avlodga o'tib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan-avlodga o'tadigan qimmatbaho buyum.

cards.ex: It takes time to get over someone you really loved.
cards.exUz: Haqiqatan ham sevgan odamingni unutish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birovni unutish va munosabatlardagi ajralishdan keyin tuzalib ketmoq.

cards.ex: We need to build bridges between different communities.
cards.exUz: Biz turli jamoalar o'rtasida ko'priklar qurishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro tushunish va hamkorlikni o'rnatmoq.

cards.ex: He's a fair-weather friend; he's only around when things are going well.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi kundosh do'st; u faqat ishlar yaxshi ketganda atrofda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat qulay paytlarda do'st bo'lib qoladigan inson.

cards.ex: We go way back; we've known each other since kindergarten.
cards.exUz: Biz qadimgi do'stmiz; biz bir-birimizni bolalar bog'chasidan beri bilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri bir-birini biladigan odamlar.

cards.ex: I'm bringing my significant other to the party.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatga sevgan insonimni olib kelyapman.
cards.uzDef: Romantik munosabatda bo'lgan inson, er yoki xotin.

cards.ex: He's a talented musician, like father, like son.
cards.exUz: U iste'dodli musiqachi, otasi bola.
cards.uzDef: Otaning xususiyatlari bolaga o'tganini bildiradi.

cards.ex: She wears the pants in their relationship.
cards.exUz: U ularning munosabatlarida boshqaruvchi.
cards.uzDef: Oila yoki munosabatlarda boshqaruvchi va qaror qabul qiluvchi inson.

cards.ex: He's a very family-oriented person; he always puts his family first.
cards.exUz: U juda oilaparvar inson; u har doim oilasini birinchi o'ringa qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari bilan vaqt o'tkazishni va ularga g'amxo'rlik qilishni afzal ko'radigan inson.

cards.ex: I always turn to my mom when I have a problem.
cards.exUz: Muammoim bo'lsa, har doim onamga murojaat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Yordam, maslahat yoki tasalli uchun birovga murojaat qilmoq.

cards.ex: After the argument, they tried to mend fences and be friends again.
cards.exUz: Tortishuvdan keyin ular munosabatlarni tiklashga va yana do'st bo'lishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan munosabatlarni tiklashga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: They've been bosom buddies since childhood.
cards.exUz: Ular bolaligidan jigarband do'stlar.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin va sodiq do'stlar.

cards.ex: They're so lovey-dovey; it's almost embarrassing to watch.
cards.exUz: Ular shunchalik ishqiy-sheroziyki, ularni tomosha qilish deyarli uyat.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy joyda juda ko'p sevgi izhor qiladigan juftlik.

cards.ex: Their marriage is on the rocks; they're considering a divorce.
cards.exUz: Ularning nikohi xavf ostida; ular ajralish haqida o'ylashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlardagi jiddiy muammolar tufayli barbod bo'lish xavfi ostida.

cards.ex: He's finally ready to settle down and start a family.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat oilaviy bo'lishga va oila qurishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Oila qurmoq, uy-joyli bo'lmoq va barqaror hayot kechirmoq.

cards.ex: I tried to change him, but a leopard can't change its spots.
cards.uz: qon bilan bitgan jon bilan chiqar
cards.exUz: Men uni o'zgartirishga harakat qildim, lekin qon bilan bitgan jon bilan chiqar.
cards.term: a leopard can't change its spots
cards.uzDef: Odamning xarakteri o'zgarmaydi.
